description: This source file provides a function to fetch analytics data related to agents from an API endpoint. It includes a utility to build query strings and exports the main API call function as well as a default object containing that function.

methods.name: getAgentsAnalytics(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches grouped analytics data for agents, supporting optional filtering parameters. Normalizes and returns the payload with items, total count, and metadata.
methods.return: Object containing items, total, and meta.

methods.name: buildQuery(params = {})

methods.return: String representing the URL query string.
